comparisonSummary: 9 direct computed sample(s) paired, with 0 stable-field differences. Read the comparison JSON for exact scope; screenshot age text and source duration are not identity/performance claims.
limits: This compares the specified genuine revisions and selected observed paths. It does not claim global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage, or a speed/performance improvement.

Recordings use their existing 25 fps cadence without editorial speed changes. The recorder caps an initial unchanged lead-in at one second and holds the final still at least one second. Capture-clock and encoded durations are retained per source.

Labelled detail scenes are actual source crops after full-viewport context leads. Held screenshots are labelled as stills in captions and provenance; full unmodified selected PNGs and MP4s remain downloadable.
No model message, real credentials, login, provider connection, paid API or paid resource was used. The genuine unconfigured-model warning remains visible.
Representative all-five-theme screenshots do not imply every scenario/theme/viewport combination was tested.

Live native resize is blocked by the preexisting 12×0px pointer grip: the real drag is a no-op and width/storage remain 420px. Issue https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18910 owns this bug; it is not fixed here.

This film verifies native opening, closing, reopening, reload and Escape at the actual 420px default, with outer 0px/inner 420px when closed. It does not claim live resize, clamp or isDragging coverage at other widths. Focused unit/compiled-CSS validation is separate.
Phone Overview entry remains blocked by known #16792. Its real blocked state is retained in the packet; no changed phone-path pass is claimed.
Erroneous intended-width filenames and the procedural resize recording are excluded; the selected bug PNG and proof JSON report actual 420px.
